visual_action: The video starts with Donald Trump speaking at a podium with the presidential seal. The image then distorts with a bulge effect focused on his mouth, with stylized text appearing over it. It then cuts to a screenshot of the official White House TikTok profile page, which shows it has 6.7 million followers. This is followed by a quick montage of clips showing Donald Trump looking serious and determined in various settings: sitting at a table, in profile with dramatic lighting, and finally saluting outdoors while wearing a large coat.

The song '67 — DJ R4' is used.
